runs.finalText:
## 查询结果

按 `experiment_code` 聚合的统计结果如下：

| experiment_code | 样本数 (distinct sample) | 观测数 | 净信号样本均值 (signal - background) |
|---|---|---|---|
| EXP-GENOME-002 | 6 | **12,000** | 1,022.425 |
| EXP-PHOTON-001 | 6 | **12,000** | 1,012.425 |

**验证结论：** ✅ 两个实验（EXP-GENOME-002 和 EXP-PHOTON-001）观测数均为 **12,000 条**，与预期一致。数据来自 `science.observations` 分区表，共 24,000 条记录，由两个子分区（`observations_2026_01` 和 `observations_2026_02`）各承载 12,000 条。

finalQuery.sql:
SELECT 
    e.experiment_code,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.sample_id) AS sample_count,
    COUNT(*) AS observation_count,
    AVG(o.signal - o.background) AS mean_net_signal
FROM science.observations o
JOIN science.experiments e ON o.experiment_id = e.experiment_id
GROUP BY e.experiment_code
ORDER BY e.experiment_code;
